title: Get Structured JSON from an LLM API, Every Single Time
description:
Tired of parsing messy AI replies? Make the model return clean JSON. 🧩

✅ Add output_config with a json_schema to your Claude API request
✅ Mark fields required and block extra keys
✅ Pipe the result through jq

Day 3 of Build AI Apps. Next up: Day 4, Give the Model a Tool to Call.
Follow for a new short every day and ship your own AI app.

#shorts #ai #coding #json #api #tutorial #programming
comment: Curl or Python: which would you parse it with? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: the JSON comes back as a string in content[0].text, so jq -r prints it ready to pipe on.
